title_sq: Shitet, Apartament 2+1+BLK, Fresk, 160,000 Euro i Diskutueshem
description_sq:
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Fresk
– Rruga Muhamed Deliu, perball restorant Frekskut
– Pallat i ri me ashensor
– Kati 7 (JO I FUNDIT)

– Siperfaqja Bruto 100.8m²

Shitet Apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe 100.8m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 7 ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor, ne Fresk prane restorant Freskut.
Ka akses te shpejte me rrugen e Dajtit, me rrugen Dalip Topi dhe dalje direkte ne unaze. Zona ofron qetesi dhe te gjitha facilitetet si shkolla, kopshte, farmaci, markete, stacione urbani etj.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, ambient ngrenie, 2 dhoma gjumi, ballkoni dhe tualeti.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar.
Disponon certefikate pronesie dhe shitet dhe me kredi.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+BLK, Fresh, 160,000 Euro Negotiable
description_en: Property Features: - 2+1 Apartment - Fresk - Muhamed Deliu Street, in front of Freskut restaurant - New building with elevator - 7th Floor (NOT THE LAST) - Furnished - Gross Area 100.8m² - Net Area 94m² - Price 160,000 Euro Negotiable 2+1 Apartment for sale, with an area of 100.8m², which is located on the 7th floor in a new building with an elevator, in Fresk, near the Fresk restaurant. There is quick access to Dajti street, Dalip Topi street and direct exit to the ring road. The area offers peace and all facilities such as schools, kindergartens, pharmacies, markets, urban stations, etc. The apartment is organized in living room, kitchen, dining room, 2 bedrooms, balcony and toilet. The apartment is sold furnished. It has ownership certificates and is sold on credit. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
